# Control Harness Bracket Quality Inspection
Highland Assembly Works | Cell 4 | 06/18/2026
Inspector: Nadia Haddad | Team assembler: Neil Kim | Lot: HAW-0618-27

## Job and criteria
Part: control harness mounting bracket, revision C. Work order 84721; sample size: 5 of 40 units. Raymond Ferreira, shift lead, supplied the approved drawing and traveler. Inspection tools: calibrated digital caliper, asset CAL-114; calibration due 09/30/2026.

| Characteristic | Acceptance criterion | Sample result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Mounting-hole spacing | 4.00 ± 0.05 in | 4.18 in on unit 3 |
| Bracket length | 6.00 ± 0.06 in | 6.01 in on unit 3 |
| Connector latch engagement | Fully seated; no visible gap | Fully seated on all 5 |
| Wire marking | Matches traveler, revision C | Matches on all 5 |
| Harness continuity | Each circuit below 1.0 Ω | Traveler requires test before release |

## Inspection notes
Visual inspection found no cracks, sharp burrs, loose terminals, or damaged insulation on the five sampled units. Inspection sequence covered connector seating, wire markings, and bracket dimensions. Unit 3 measured 4.18 in between mounting-hole centers, against the drawing tolerance of 3.95–4.05 in.

The sampled units pass dimensional acceptance. Hold the lot from packing pending engineering disposition of unit 3 and completion of the required continuity tests. Nadia recorded the measurements on traveler 84721 and notified Raymond Ferreira at 2:35 PM. The remaining 35 units are staged in tote 12 beside Cell 4; no rework has been recorded as of 2:45 PM.

errors.explanation: The traveler requires a continuity test on each circuit before release, but the listed inspection sequence omits that required test, and no continuity results are recorded.
errors.fix: Inspection sequence covered connector seating, wire markings, bracket dimensions, and continuity testing on each circuit.
